def select_next_node(current_node: int, depot: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray,
                     rest_capacity: float, demands: np.ndarray,
                     distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    if unvisited_nodes.size == 0:
        return depot

    d_cur = distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes]
    d_dep = distance_matrix[depot][unvisited_nodes]
    base = d_cur - 0.6 * d_dep

    span = float(base.max() - base.min()) if base.size > 1 else 0.0
    band = 1e-3 * span + 1e-12

    best = int(np.argmin(base))
    best_score = base[best]

    mask = base <= best_score + band
    candidates = unvisited_nodes[mask]
    cand_base = base[mask]

    if candidates.size == 1:
        return int(candidates[0])

    # Capacity-fit refinement: prefer customer filling the remaining capacity well
    dem = demands[candidates]
    fill = rest_capacity - dem
    # Prefer smaller leftover capacity (better fit), tie-break by base score
    order = np.lexsort((cand_base, fill))
    return int(candidates[order[0]])
